text_blocks.snippet: U.S. citizens can enter Barbados visa-free for up to six months with a valid U.S. passport. You'll also need proof of your intended departure from Barbados, such as a return or onward ticket. Additionally, you'll need to complete an online Immigration and Customs form before arrival.

list.snippet: Passport: A valid U.S. passport is required for entry.
Visa: No visa is required for stays up to six months for U.S. citizens.
Return Ticket: You must have a valid return or onward ticket to your country of residence.
Intended Address: You will need to provide the address where you will be staying in Barbados.
Evidence of Funds: You may be asked to show proof that you have sufficient funds to support your stay.
ED Card: You will need to complete an online Immigration and Customs form (ED Card) before arrival.
